title: Red Hat Security Advisory: yggdrasil security update
description: Multiple denial of service vulnerabilities have been identified in the yggdrasil system daemon used in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10. These issues stem from excessive processing or recursion in various Golang libraries such as crypto/x509, encoding/asn1, net/url, crypto/tls, and net/http. The vulnerabilities allow denial of service conditions through excessive DNS SAN processing, recursion in ASN.1 unmarshalling, quadratic complexity in URL path resolution, indefinite TLS KeyUpdate messages, and excessive HTTP/2 SETTINGS frames. Red Hat has issued an important security update addressing these issues.
